scope: Printed Seytek page 983, rows 1–40; proposal only
method: Line-by-line comparison with extracted Kyrgyz and adjacent page 982 / page 983 context; lexical checks noted below

lexical_refs.заар: https://el-sozduk.kg/%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%B0%D1%80/ — fierceness, wrath, severity in epic use
lexical_refs.бейпай: https://el-sozduk.kg/%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%B9%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%B9/ — suffering or turmoil; бейпайга сал- inflicts suffering
lexical_refs.касам: https://el-sozduk.kg/%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BC/ — oath; line 29 may instead reflect казам (fate/death), unresolved

uncertainty: Rows 7–31 contain first-person Sarybay speech but no extracted opening quotation mark. Page 982 ends in third-person narration; page 983 row 54 begins another explicit quote. Do not infer exact quotation boundary from this text alone.
Rows 10, 23, 27 and 29 have unclear or possibly corrupt wording. Proposed English preserves defensible gist and requires printed-page/lexical review before adoption.
The form жолундуу in row 23 was not confirmed in the consulted dictionary; the English is context-led.
Row 29's касам literally means oath, while epic kazam/ажал idiom might be intended; check scan before changing source text.

corrections.en: He had kept the tumult raging.
corrections.reason: Чууга сал- is to throw into uproar; continues page 982 battle narration.

corrections.en: Strength spent, exhausted,
corrections.reason: Чама is strength or capacity here, not a person's name; ал кетип means strength departed.

corrections.en: Blood flowed from our bodies,
corrections.reason: Денебизден is first-person plural, from our bodies.

corrections.en: For saliva sweeter than sugar,
corrections.reason: Together with next line, the speaker longs for even one swallow.

corrections.en: We longed for a single swallow.
corrections.reason: Бир жутууга зар болду expresses desperate longing for one swallow; pronoun follows our bodies in row 3.

corrections.en: Bravo, Kuyaly!
corrections.reason: Баракелде is praise or admiration, not a blessing noun.

corrections.old: What can I say without Bali,
corrections.en: How could I fail to say, 'Well done'?
corrections.reason: Бали is an exclamation of praise, not the place name.

corrections.old: Your courage is strong, your urine is strong,
corrections.en: Your valor is mighty, your wrath fierce;
corrections.reason: Заар has figurative epic sense fierceness or wrath, not urine in this context.

corrections.en: I brought Sarybay to heel.
corrections.reason: Сарыбайды is the object and кылдым is first person; this may mark a speaker shift because the surrounding passage seems to address Kuyaly and later says 'I was Sarybay the khan.' Check printed punctuation and narrator before adoption.

corrections.en: My poor head was sorely tried,
corrections.reason: Башка is dative 'to the head,' not adjective 'other'; башына күч келүү expresses affliction.

corrections.en: The final ordeal came upon me.
corrections.reason: Акыр-такыр signals the utter/endmost stage; иш is trouble in this lament.

corrections.en: I was Sarybay the khan,
corrections.reason: Кан here is the title khan, not blood; first-person speech.

corrections.en: From time immemorial,
corrections.reason: Ар качандан бир качан is a temporal epic formula; smooth without adding an event.

corrections.en: At every turn,
corrections.reason: Ар дайымдан бир дайым reiterates habitual recurrence.

corrections.en: Fighting had been my custom.
corrections.reason: Кагыш кылган адатым names the habit as combat, with no 'bad' modifier.

corrections.en: Countless armies
corrections.reason: Кол means an army or troop in epic battle context, not anatomical hands.

corrections.en: I fought and crushed,
corrections.reason: Кагыш кылып is to fight; clause continues into next line.

corrections.en: And cast them all into misery.
corrections.reason: Бейпайга салдым баарысын means caused all to suffer, not free acquisition.

corrections.en: I used to fell the middling ones;
corrections.reason: Чамалууну is the moderately capable person, object of чалчу элек (habitual 'used to strike/fell'), not a name.

corrections.old: If you want to fight the stump
corrections.en: When a fierce fighting foe came,
corrections.reason: Чабышкан дүмөк жоо is a fighting, tumultuous enemy; conditional келсе, not a wish.

corrections.old: He didn't put it on his back,
corrections.en: I used to lay him flat on his back.
corrections.reason: Чалкасынан салчу элек is affirmative habitual in the speaker's first-person account.

corrections.old: He did not destroy the road,
corrections.en: I used to destroy even the formidable ones,
corrections.reason: Жойчу элек is affirmative habitual; жолундууну denotes a type of adversary here, not 'the road'; exact lexical sense uncertain.

corrections.en: And those who crept close,
corrections.reason: Жойлоп is a manner of coming close, not a name.

corrections.en: I used to gouge out their glaring eyes.
corrections.reason: Көзүн ойчу элек is affirmative habitual 'used to gouge out the eye'; кашайткан qualifies the eyes.

corrections.en: When they came swaggering,
corrections.reason: Кулжуңдаша кеткенде indicates taunting or cocky behavior, not departure by 'you'.

corrections.en: I left them at their wits' end,
corrections.reason: Айласын кетирип is to deprive of recourse; күн may add a 'daylight' nuance not captured here.

corrections.old: He put it on his back.
corrections.en: And laid them flat on their backs.
corrections.reason: Чалкасынан салчу элек repeats speaker's habitual victory, as at row 22.

corrections.en: Yet my appointed end had not come.
corrections.reason: Context contrasts past victories with surviving to face Kuyaly; касам is lexically 'oath' and may be a source variant or typo, so this is provisional.

corrections.old: The discharge is severe, the urine is strong,
corrections.en: Swift to flee, fierce in wrath,
corrections.reason: Качышы is fleeing, заары wrath/fierceness; not medical discharge and urine.

corrections.old: I've never seen you like that.
corrections.en: My dear, I had never seen your like.
corrections.reason: Сендей көрбөдүм means never saw one like you; кайраным is an address.

corrections.old: I heard from the reporter yesterday.
corrections.en: Yesterday I heard word from a messenger,
corrections.reason: Кабарчы is messenger or news bearer in the epic setting; keep sentence flowing into next line.

corrections.en: My tiny life trembled,
corrections.reason: Чымын жаным is figurative 'my frail life'; чыркырап is shrill quivering or crying.

corrections.en: The bones of my thighs shuddered,
corrections.reason: Дал сан сөөгүм is thigh bone; быркырап expresses rattling/shuddering, not necessarily a literal fracture.

corrections.en: My ribs throbbed,
corrections.reason: Боконо сөөгүм names ribs specifically; болкулдап conveys throbbing or jolting.

corrections.en: My insides heaved without cease,
corrections.reason: Ичим солкулдап evokes internal trembling; болбой intensifies the distress.

corrections.en: The news spread among the people:
corrections.reason: Калкка кабар билинген says the news became known to the people; next line gives its content.

corrections.en: 'A fearsome fiend has come,' they said.
corrections.reason: Кара тажаал is a terrible fiend, not boredom; келди деп reports what was said.

corrections.en: Poor champion Sarybay,
corrections.reason: Кайран is an epithet of pity; балбан is champion or wrestler; continuation in row 41 completes sentence.
